def prepare_mac_header(token, uri, key, http_method, nonce=None, headers=
    None, body=None, ext='', hash_algorithm='hmac-sha-1', issue_time=None,
    draft=0):
    """Add an `MAC Token`_ to the request authorization header.

    .. _`MAC Token`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-http-mac-01
    """
    headers = headers or {}

    # Generate nonce if not provided
    if nonce is None:
        if issue_time is not None:
            age = utils.generate_age(issue_time)
            nonce = '{0}:{1}'.format(age, common.generate_nonce())
        else:
            nonce = '{0}:{1}'.format(0, common.generate_nonce())

    # Parse the URI
    sch, net, path, par, query, fra = urlparse(uri)

    # Compute the request URI (path + query)
    if query:
        request_uri = path + '?' + query
    else:
        request_uri = path

    # Get the host and port
    if ':' in net:
        host, port = net.split(':', 1)
    else:
        host = net
        port = '443' if sch == 'https' else '80'

    # Compute body hash if body is present
    body_hash = ''
    if body:
        if hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-1':
            body_hash = b2a_base64(hashlib.sha1(body.encode('utf-8')).digest()).decode('utf-8').strip()
        elif hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-256':
            body_hash = b2a_base64(hashlib.sha256(body.encode('utf-8')).digest()).decode('utf-8').strip()

    # Build the normalized request string
    if draft == 0:
        # draft 00 format
        base_string = '\n'.join([
            nonce,
            http_method.upper(),
            request_uri,
            host,
            port,
            body_hash,
            ext or '',
            ''  # trailing newline
        ])
    else:
        # draft 01 format
        base_string = '\n'.join([
            nonce,
            http_method.upper(),
            request_uri,
            host,
            port,
            body_hash,
            ext or '',
            ''  # trailing newline
        ])

    # Compute the HMAC signature
    if hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-1':
        digestmod = hashlib.sha1
    elif hash_algorithm == 'hmac-sha-256':
        digestmod = hashlib.sha256
    else:
        raise ValueError('Unknown hash algorithm: %s' % hash_algorithm)

    if isinstance(key, str):
        key = key.encode('utf-8')
    if isinstance(base_string, str):
        base_string = base_string.encode('utf-8')

    mac = b2a_base64(hmac.new(key, base_string, digestmod).digest()).decode('utf-8').strip()

    # Build the Authorization header
    if draft == 0:
        header = 'MAC id="{token}", nonce="{nonce}"'.format(token=token, nonce=nonce)
        if body_hash:
            header += ', bodyhash="{body_hash}"'.format(body_hash=body_hash)
        if ext:
            header += ', ext="{ext}"'.format(ext=ext)
        header += ', mac="{mac}"'.format(mac=mac)
    else:
        header = 'MAC id="{token}", nonce="{nonce}"'.format(token=token, nonce=nonce)
        if body_hash:
            header += ', bodyhash="{body_hash}"'.format(body_hash=body_hash)
        if ext:
            header += ', ext="{ext}"'.format(ext=ext)
        header += ', mac="{mac}"'.format(mac=mac)

    headers['Authorization'] = header
    return headers
